errors.invalid_description: Write at least 10 characters in the job description
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to edit this listing
errors.vacancy_locked: This listing was hidden by a moderator
errors.generic: Could not save. Check your internet and try again — your answers are kept
errors.photo_invalid: We couldn't read this image, or it isn't a photo. Choose another JPG, PNG or WEBP photo
errors.photo_unavailable: The photo couldn't be checked right now. Upload it again or continue without a photo

moderation.pending_desc: We will let you know when the review is finished. It usually takes a few minutes.
moderation.review_title: Your listing is under additional review
moderation.review_desc: A moderator will review it and let you know. Until then the listing is not visible to others.
moderation.rejected_desc: Ish topdim accepts only job and job-seeker listings. Please change the unrelated or prohibited part of your text.
moderation.verification_desc: Your first vacancy goes public once you are verified as an employer. This usually takes one working day.
moderation.edit_hint: Change the marked field and publish again. Your other answers are kept.
moderation.field_flagged: Change this part: it contains unrelated or prohibited content.

alerts.title: Telegram notifications
alerts.intro: You post a listing — the system finds a matching job or worker and tells you in Telegram. Only with your consent.
alerts.hint: Via Telegram. You can stop any time.
alerts.on_desc_worker: We will message you in Telegram when a new job matches you by 90% or more.
alerts.on_desc_employer: We will message you in Telegram when a candidate matches your vacancy by 90% or more.
alerts.needs_bot_desc: Tap the button, then press «Start» in Telegram. Notifications turn on once the bot can message you.
alerts.waiting: Waiting for you to press «Start» in the bot…
alerts.bot_missing: The Telegram bot is not configured yet. Please try later.
alerts.profession_any: Any job that matches my listing
alerts.schedules_hint: If none is selected — any schedule.
alerts.privacy: Messages never include phone numbers. Contacts open in the app only with the owner's consent.

matches.title: Matching jobs and candidates
matches.explain: The percentage is a calculated match between the listing and the profile (not a hiring probability). We notify in Telegram about pairs of {threshold}% or more with no hard mismatches.
matches.jobs_empty: No matching jobs yet. We will tell you when one appears.
matches.candidates_empty: No matching candidates yet. We will tell you when they appear.
matches.hard_fail: A mandatory requirement is not met — not recommended automatically.
matches.incomplete_worker: Some of your details are missing — complete your profile for a more accurate match.
matches.incomplete_candidate: The candidate has not provided some details.
matches.none: Post a listing first to see matches.

verification.title: Employer verification
verification.intro: Your first vacancy goes public once you are verified. Later vacancies go through the regular review.
verification.no_employer: Post a vacancy first — a verification request is created automatically.

status_desc.unverified: Send your details — an administrator will check them.
status_desc.pending: An administrator is checking your details. Usually one working day.
status_desc.verified: Below is exactly what was checked.
status_desc.rejected: Read the reason and send your details again.
status_desc.suspended: Your vacancies are temporarily hidden. Please contact support.

check.phone_missing: Phone number is not confirmed yet
check.name: Name or organization name checked

verification.id_hint: Organization tax ID — 9 digits, personal ID — 14 digits.
verification.id_required: For an organization or sole proprietor enter a 9-digit tax ID or a 14-digit personal ID.
verification.note_placeholder: For example: a cafe in Chilonzor
verification.docs_hint: A photo of a certificate or license. Documents are stored privately and seen only by authorized staff.

errors.invalid_identity_number: Invalid number: it must have 9 or 14 digits.
errors.identity_number_required: A tax ID is required for an organization.
errors.invalid_status: Details cannot be sent in the current status.

photo.title: Workplace photo (optional)

photo.bad_type: Only JPG, PNG or WEBP images.
photo.too_large: The image must be under 5 MB.
photo.failed: Could not upload the photo. Please try again.
photo.invalid: We couldn't read this image, or it isn't a photo. Choose another photo.

ai.choose: How do you want to prepare the listing?
ai.vacancy_label: Describe in plain words who you need
ai.worker_example: E.g.: I'm an accountant with 3 years of experience, I live in Chilonzor, looking for a job from 6 million.
ai.vacancy_example: E.g.: My cafe in Chilonzor needs 2 cooks, 5–7 million, 6-day week, experienced.
ai.note: AI uses only what you wrote: it never invents experience, salary or conditions. Nothing is published until you check it.
ai.too_short: Write at least a sentence or two
ai.ready: AI prepared your listing. Check it and publish.
ai.ready_note: Check every line — tap “Change” if something is wrong.

errors.ai_disabled: AI is not available now. Please fill in the listing yourself.
errors.ai_busy: AI is busy. Try again in a minute or fill it in yourself.
errors.ai_failed: AI couldn't prepare it. Try again or fill it in yourself.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit.
errors.prohibited: Ish topdim accepts only job and job-seeker listings. Please change the unrelated or prohibited part of your text.
errors.validation: Write at least a sentence or two (up to 1500 characters).

aihub.title: AI assistant
aihub.subtitle: Helps you find the right match faster. Results come only from real listings.
aihub.search_desc_jobs: For example: "evening shift cashier in Chilonzor". We work out the job, area and terms.
aihub.search_desc_workers: For example: "experienced electrician in Yunusobod". We work out the job, area and terms.
aihub.matches_desc: Fit calculated from your profile (job, area, experience, pay) and why
aihub.pro_desc: A Telegram message as soon as a fitting listing appears
aihub.fill_desc_worker: Describe yourself in plain words — the fields fill in, you check and publish
aihub.fill_desc_employer: Describe who you need in plain words — the fields fill in, you check and publish
aihub.candidates_desc: Workers ranked by your vacancy requirements
aihub.note: AI only assists: the decision is yours. We never show a match percentage that was not calculated.
